notes:
- Fixed: the first drop after taking a stocking off no longer snaps straight to the floor - it now falls from your hand down to your feet
- Fixed: the dropped stocking could land in a different spot for other players than for you
- Fixed: Menu Hold L/R now shows the stocking in your hand to other players too (including late joiners)
- New: Blendshapes when taken off - drive a blendshape (e.g. the body's sock-shrink key) as the stocking comes off: per leg or both, at once or gradually over a range you choose; a shape covering both legs is split per leg automatically
- Note: stockings re-bake automatically the next time you press Play
